latest.title: Computation of unknotting numbers: which knot breaks the Bernhard-Jablan Conjecture
latest.abstract: We determine $2,525$ unknotting numbers of prime knots with at most $13$ crossings, that are unknown in the KnotInfo snapshot of 9 September 2026. The lower-bound calculations use Heegaard Floer correction-term obstructions and Greene's spanning-tree model. We also give explicit crossing-change constructions for upper bounds. For $959$ alternating knots with range $[2,3]$, we verify that no crossing change in a minimal diagram gives a knot of unknotting number one. We determine the unknotting numbers of all four knots in Brittenham and Hermiller's construction and thereby identify 13n3370 as an explicit counterexample to the original Bernhard-Jablan conjecture.
latest.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
latest.workSummary: 计算至多 13 交叉素结中 2525 个此前未知解结数，并声称确定原 Bernhard–Jablan 猜想的显式反例。
latest.breakthrough: 把上下界匹配和可检查构造结合，识别 13n3370 的反例角色。
latest.limitations: 未知范围相对于指定 KnotInfo 快照；需核查计算证书与原猜想版本。 当前为摘要级分析，技术细节与结论须回查原文。
